programs.title: Egypt's Sun King: Secrets And Treasures
programs.desc: A story about the discovery of archaeologists from Basel who came to Dolny Królów many years ago.They began to examine tombs that had been found already in the 19th century.However, at that time they were considered irrelevant.In the crypt covered with rubble, the Swiss found numerous wooden elements with symbols referring to Amenhotep III.During his reign, Egypt prospered.Faron ordered many temples, palaces and statues to be built.Scientists also found a woman's mummy.It was quickly determined that the remains belonged to Queen Tiaa.There were thirty more embalmed bodies in the tunnels.The creators will answer the question who were the people buried next to the ruler.

programs.title: Hitler's Gold
programs.desc: The creators of the four-episode series analyze the economic background of the Third Reich, tracking secret accounts and hidden treasures.They discover the financial support of industrialists that helped Hitler gain power.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation 21
programs.desc: Reconstructions of real plane crashes.By recreating the course of events, the program's creators try to understand what led to the unfortunate events.They recreate the circumstances in which the tragedy occurred: the weather, the atmosphere on board the plane, the decisions and actions of the pilots.They also show the work of people investigating the causes of disasters and conduct a computer flight simulation.Viewers can hear various comments from specialists and testimonies of witnesses to these events.The creators of the program will prove that air accidents are often caused by human slowness and lack of imagination.Each disaster is thoroughly analyzed and the lessons learned help minimize the number of tragedies in the future.

programs.title: Corée, une guerre sans fin
programs.desc: A story about a conflict that still affects international relations, including those between superpowers.Many historians considered the Korean War, which took place from 1950 to 1953, to be the most important conflict since 1945.After the opening of archives in Russia, the United States, China and South Korea, new materials were made available, including color films and hundreds of photos.They allow us to take a fresh look at this fateful confrontation, which largely shaped the face of the modern world.

programs.title: 1946: Tokyo Files
programs.desc: The story of the trial of the leaders of the Empire of Greater Japan.Unlike the Nuremberg legal proceedings, it was forgotten, even though nearly 20 million people died as a result of the conflict in the Pacific.The authors will describe how the Americans manipulated the tribunal in order to gain an advantage over the Soviets.They spared Hirohito, who retained his dignity as emperor after the surrender.The realities of the Cold War turned the former US enemy into a strategic ally.The creators used the judge's private archives.These documents constitute evidence of the political game in the post-war reality.
